title: Pokémon Company to use facial recognition in stores to combat card resale
summary: The company implements facial scanners in Japanese stores to verify age and limit purchases of card packs, as a measure against speculators.

title: PlayStation fans call for a week-long blackout in protest of the possible end of physical discs
summary: The community plans to not turn on their consoles for a week in August as a sign of rejection of Sony's strategy to eliminate the physical format.

title: Xbox servers suffer a global outage blocking access to digital and physical games
summary: The interruption of the Xbox Network service prevented users from playing both digital and physical titles, generating criticism about digital dependence.

title: Square Enix hints at more Final Fantasy remakes and possible new director for the saga
summary: The company suggests it plans to expand the franchise's remakes with more ambitious installments and possible changes in creative direction.

title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls faces technical issues on PC and Arc System Works apologizes
summary: The fighting game suffered serious performance issues during the open beta on PC, leading the studio to offer a public apology.

title: Capcom plans to release a Resident Evil each year and bets on remakes
summary: The company's strategy includes annual re-releases of the survival horror saga, using remakes as a pillar to maintain constant interest.

title: STALKER 2: Heart of Chornobyl receives its first major expansion 'Cost of Hope' in August
summary: Update 2.0 and the story DLC will arrive on August 20, adding dozens of hours of content and technical improvements to the game.

title: Cyan Worlds shows discarded prototype of a new Myst and confirms that another game in the saga is in development
summary: The studio reveals images of a canceled project called 'Project Anglerfish', while working on a different installment of the Myst series.

title: Halo remake leads Japanese releases of the week with an enhanced version
summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved tops the new releases in Japan, while reviews highlight the visual quality of water in the remake.

title: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind can now be played in a web browser
summary: Thanks to a fan-made port, Bethesda's classic RPG runs directly in the browser without the need for additional downloads.

title: Splatoon Raiders becomes one of the highest-rated user games on Metacritic
summary: The shooter climbs to the top 10 of best user-reviewed games, dethroning Assassin's Creed in the UK charts.

title: Rockstar and Take-Two executives defend the sale of games in physical format
summary: Dan Houser and Rockstar's co-founder speak in favor of companies continuing to offer discs if players demand them.

title: The actor from the Zelda movie shares his memories of Breath of the Wild and talks about his role as Link
summary: The performer of the hero of Hyrule reflects on his experience on set and the memories that the video game brings him.

title: Shigeru Miyamoto believes that players no longer care so much about technical specifications of consoles
summary: The Nintendo creative opines that the company focuses on offering unique gameplay instead of competing in raw power.
